from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,time,resource,signal,sys
from fractions import Fraction
import sympy as s
ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'code'))
import classification_reduced_m3_whole_source as C
import classification_plane_m4_special_review as H
JOB='research/classification/jobs/plane_m2_triangle_h21_whole_source.json'
OUT='reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_M2_TRIANGLE_H21_WHOLE_SOURCE_20261108.json'
started=time.monotonic();signal.alarm(180);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
contract=json.loads((ROOT/JOB).read_text())
for item in contract['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/item['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],item['path']
assert not(ROOT/OUT).exists()
x=C.x;a,b,c,u,v=x
old=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_M2_TRIANGLE_DOUBLE_21_20261107.json').read_text())
B1=[C.from_vector(row)for row in old['full30_weight1_basis']];B2=[C.from_vector(row)for row in old['full9_weight2_basis']]
X=[H.a(1,i)for i in range(5)];gauges=[]
for normal in (3,4):
 for i in range(3):
  Y=[{}for _ in range(5)];Y[i]=H.a(1,normal);gauges.append(C.literal(H.wedge(X,Y)))
E=s.Matrix.hstack(*(C.vec(P)for P in B1+gauges));raw1=[i for i,(ij,e)in enumerate(H.COLS)if e[3]+e[4]-sum(k>=3 for k in ij)==1]
assert len(raw1)==36;Ei=E[raw1,:].inv();assert E[raw1,:]*Ei==s.eye(36)
def project1(P):return Ei*C.vec(P)[raw1,:]
def weight(P,k):return{ij:s.expand(sum(co*s.prod(xx**n for xx,n in zip(x,e))for e,co in s.Poly(p,*x).terms()if e[3]+e[4]-sum(at>=3 for at in ij)==k))for ij,p in P.items()}
def minus(P):return{ij:-p for ij,p in P.items()}
def enc(M):return [[str(s.factor(z))for z in row]for row in M.tolist()]
def emat(P):return {str(ij):str(s.factor(z))for ij,z in P.items()}
def basis2vals(P):
 vv=C.vec(P);ans=[]
 for Q in B2:
  col=C.vec(Q);at=next(i for i,z in enumerate(col)if z);assert col[at]==1;ans.append(vv[at])
 assert C.vec(P)==sum((z*C.vec(Q)for z,Q in zip(ans,B2)),s.zeros(150,1));return s.Matrix(ans)
records=[]
for item in old['cases']:
 name=item['r'];P0=C.from_vector(item['full150_P0']);K=s.Matrix(item['full30_weight1_kernel']).applyfunc(C.scalar).T
 k=K.cols;assert k in(7,8)
 unit=[]
 for j in range(6):
  gs=[int(i==j)for i in range(6)];unit.append(project1(weight(C.push(P0,gs),1))[:30,:])
 S=s.Matrix.hstack(*unit);ind=list(S.rref()[1]);cols=[S[:,j]for j in ind];res=[]
 for j in range(k):
  if s.Matrix.hstack(*cols,K[:,j]).rank()>len(cols):cols.append(K[:,j]);res.append(j)
 assert len(cols)==k
 free=[j for j in range(30)if j not in item['J1_certificate']['columns']]
 assert K[free,:]==s.eye(k)
 A=s.Matrix.hstack(*cols);Cmat=A[free,:];Ci=Cmat.inv();assert K*Cmat==A and Cmat*Ci==s.eye(k)
 # The entire finite six-shear push, not merely six tangent directions.
 sig=s.symbols('sigma0:6');finite=project1(weight(C.push(P0,sig),1));assert finite[:30,:]==S*s.Matrix(sig)
 # Simultaneous all original K1 coefficients and FULL9 inhomogeneous P2.
 alpha=s.symbols('alpha0:'+str(k));rawq=s.symbols('rawq0:9')
 original=C.plus(P0,{ij:sum(alpha[j]*sum(K[i,j]*B1[i][ij]for i in range(30))for j in range(k))for ij in H.PAIRS},{ij:sum(rawq[j]*B2[j][ij]for j in range(9))for ij in H.PAIRS})
 coords=Ci*s.Matrix(alpha);inverse_shear=[s.S.Zero]*6
 for at,j in enumerate(ind):inverse_shear[j]=-coords[at]
 changed=C.push(original,inverse_shear);assert weight(changed,0)==P0
 changed1=project1(weight(changed,1));expected1=sum((coords[len(ind)+n]*K[:,j]for n,j in enumerate(res)),s.zeros(30,1))
 assert changed1[:30,:]==expected1
 qnew=basis2vals(weight(changed,2));shifts=(qnew-s.Matrix(rawq)).applyfunc(s.factor)
 assert all(not z.free_symbols.intersection(set(rawq))for z in shifts)
 # Actual inverse = undo gauge and inverse shear; qnew=qraw+shift(alpha)
 # is a global polynomial triangular inverse in ALL9 variables.
 r=s.symbols('r0:'+str(len(res)));q=s.symbols('q0:9')
 P1={ij:s.expand(sum(r[n]*sum(K[i,j]*B1[i][ij]for i in range(30))for n,j in enumerate(res)))for ij in H.PAIRS}
 P=C.plus(P0,P1,{ij:sum(q[j]*B2[j][ij]for j in range(9))for ij in H.PAIRS})
 JV=C.jvector(C.jac(P));M=s.Matrix(item['full350by9_J2']).applyfunc(C.scalar);cert=item['J2_certificate'];rr,cc=cert['rows'],cert['columns'];free2=[j for j in range(9)if j not in cc]
 at=M[rr,cc];assert at.det()==C.scalar(cert['minor_determinant']);base=JV.subs(dict.fromkeys(q,0))
 assert JV[rr,:]==base[rr,:]+M[rr,:]*s.Matrix(q)
 values=at.inv()*(-base[rr,:]-(M[rr,free2]*s.Matrix([q[j]for j in free2])if free2 else s.zeros(len(rr),1)))
 sol={q[j]:s.factor(z)for j,z in zip(cc,values)}
 normalized={ij:s.expand(z.subs(sol))for ij,z in P.items()};J=JV.subs(sol).applyfunc(s.factor);D=C.actual(normalized)
 distinct=sorted({str(z)for z in J if z})
 factored=s.factor(D)
 # A proper b factor is a whole-polynomial certificate; no generic parameter
 # specialization is used. Nonfactor families remain explicit and OPEN.
 bfactor=s.expand(D.subs(b,0))==0
 case=dict(r=name,K1_dimension=k,actual_shear_rank=len(ind),independent_shear_indices=ind,residual_original_kernel_indices=res,
  complete_shear_30by6=enc(S),K1_free_coordinate_indices=free,complete_source_change_matrix=enc(Cmat),complete_global_source_inverse=enc(Ci),constant_source_determinant=str(Cmat.det()),
  all_alpha_parameters=list(map(str,alpha)),all_raw9_P2_parameters=list(map(str,rawq)),full_actual_inverse_shear=list(map(str,inverse_shear)),full_Euler_weight1_gauge_coefficients=list(map(str,changed1[30:,:])),
  all9_P2_triangular_shifts=list(map(str,shifts)),all_alpha_and_raw9_simultaneous_inverse_verified=True,
  normalized_residual_parameters=list(map(str,r)),normalized_P1=emat(P1),full_nine_P2_parameters=list(map(str,q)),P2_same_minor_rows=rr,P2_same_minor_columns=cc,P2_same_minor_determinant=str(at.det()),P2_solution={str(j):str(z)for j,z in sol.items()},P2_free_parameters=[str(q[j])for j in free2],
  normalized_complete_source=emat(normalized),all350_original_Jacobi_after_affine_P2=list(map(str,J)),all_distinct_nonzero_remaining_Jacobi=distinct,actual_D=str(D),actual_D_factorization=str(factored),whole_b_factor=bfactor,exact_b_factor_quotient=str(s.cancel(D/b))if bfactor else None,
  all_parameter_inverse_denominators_constant=all(not s.denom(z).free_symbols for z in list(Ci)+list(sol.values())),whole_source_status='irreducible_quintic_empty_by_b_factor'if bfactor else'FULL_FAMILY_SAVED_STRUCTURE_PENDING')
 records.append(case);print(name,'shear',len(ind),'res',res,'P2free',free2,'J',distinct,'factor',factored,flush=True)
result=dict(task_id='E_reduced_nonnormal',all_whole_source_arithmetic_passed=True,cases=records,scope='All10 fixed triangle H21 saved complete K1 sources; full global actual shear inverse, all9 affine P2/remaining original350/whole actualD. Factor conclusions only as explicitly certified; nonfactor families saved without parent/component claim.',no_new_M1_point_profile_wall_or_jet=True,input_bindings=contract['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],inline_source=contract['inline_source'],inline_source_sha256=contract['inline_source_sha256'],seconds=time.monotonic()-started,maximum_RSS_KiB=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
with(ROOT/OUT).open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k]for k in('all_whole_source_arithmetic_passed','seconds','maximum_RSS_KiB')}))
